title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00047 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:30: Inspected and greased grapple. R/b spear BHA.
00:30 - 00:45: Performed TBT for r/u CSG handling equipment.
00:45 - 01:30: R/u handling equipment for pulling 7" tubing. Installed spooler unit.
01:30 - 02:30: Pulled out with ASV/FLX assy. Installed FMS slips. L/d ASV/FLX and pup joint. Performed LRA readings.
02:30 - 05:15: POOH with 7" tubing from 236 to surface. Average pulling speed 8 jnts/hr. Performed LRA readings every 5th joint.
05:15 - 06:00: Removed FMS slips and installed master bushing r/d casing tong.
06:00 - 06:15: P/u and m/u spear BHA RIH to 41m
06:15 - 07:45: RIH w/ spear BHA on 5,5in DP from 41 m to 754m. RIH speed 475m/h
07:45 - 08:00: Recorded weights up-92t, down-86t
08:00 - 08:30: Engaged spear, pulled tubing free at 168t hook weight. No indication of pins shearing noticed when tubing went free
08:30 - 09:00: Observed backflow from the tubing. Pulled one stand and monitored backflow. No change
09:00 - 10:30: Continued to POOH wet from 754m to 81m
10:30 - 10:45: Flowchecked well for 15 min. Stable
10:45 - 11:00: POOH w/ fish from 81m to 41 m. Meanwhile held TBT for rigging up casing tongs
11:00 - 12:00: Installed casgin tongs over well center, changed ps21 slips to master bushing
12:00 - 12:15: Performed pre-job meeting to release spear from the fish
12:15 - 12:45: Released spear and inspected grapple. Grapple in good condition. R/b spear BHA in derrick
12:45 - 13:45: Broke off cut. Observed high torque. Changed elevator inserts and pulled out 1x single, removed clamp and l/d same
13:45 - 14:00: Cleaned and inspected swage before m/u
14:00 - 15:15: M/u swage. Overtorqued connection due to wrong setting on casing tongs. Broke off swedge and inspected connection. Performed TBT prior to pull out overtorqued box
15:15 - 16:00: POOH w/ tubing with overtorqued box, arranged double securing to box. Set slips, removed double securing to box. Removed clamp and broke off single, l/d same
16:00 - 17:00: Inspected box treads

sections.text: Inspected and greased grapple. R/b spear BHA.
Performed TBT for r/u CSG handling equipment.
R/u handling equipment for pulling 7" tubing. Installed spooler unit.
Pulled out with ASV/FLX assy. Installed FMS slips. L/d ASV/FLX and pup joint. Performed LRA readings.
POOH with 7" tubing from 236 to surface. Average pulling speed 8 jnts/hr. Performed LRA readings every 5th joint.
Removed FMS slips and installed master bushing r/d casing tong.
P/u and m/u spear BHA RIH to 41m
RIH w/ spear BHA on 5,5in DP from 41 m to 754m. RIH speed 475m/h
Recorded weights up-92t, down-86t
Engaged spear, pulled tubing free at 168t hook weight. No indication of pins shearing noticed when tubing went free
Observed backflow from the tubing. Pulled one stand and monitored backflow. No change
Continued to POOH wet from 754m to 81m
Flowchecked well for 15 min. Stable
POOH w/ fish from 81m to 41 m. Meanwhile held TBT for rigging up casing tongs
Installed casgin tongs over well center, changed ps21 slips to master bushing
Performed pre-job meeting to release spear from the fish
Released spear and inspected grapple. Grapple in good condition. R/b spear BHA in derrick
Broke off cut. Observed high torque. Changed elevator inserts and pulled out 1x single, removed clamp and l/d same
Cleaned and inspected swage before m/u
M/u swage. Overtorqued connection due to wrong setting on casing tongs. Broke off swedge and inspected connection. Performed TBT prior to pull out overtorqued box
POOH w/ tubing with overtorqued box, arranged double securing to box. Set slips, removed double securing to box. Removed clamp and broke off single, l/d same
Inspected box treads. P/u backup 7in pup w/ expandable plug. Alligned pup over stump, made up 2x turns with chain tong, removed elevators and m/u connection w/ casing tong
M/u swedge to 7in tubing
R/d casing tong
M/u stand of 5. 5in DP to swedge. Changed out master bushing to ps21 slips
RIH w/ 7in tubing on 5,5in DP from 1816m to 2541m Filled pipe every 250m
M/u TDS, RIH to 2578m
Performed pre-job meeting for cement operation
Installed cement stand, m/u TDS again, installed cement hose. End of tubing is at 2581m before started pumping

Circulated 45m3 of SW at 3000lpm/89bar. When 40m3 pumped pulled string to 2580m. 0. 3 HC gas observed in returns. Circulated additional 10m3 of SW. Totally circulated 55m3 of SW. Pumped 20m3 of wash pill at 2700lpm/76bar
Pressure tested last line connection to pump in sub to 310bar for 3 min. Good test. Bled off pressure to 20bar. Opened LTV and confirmed line up.
